name: @activepieces/piece-pdf4me
description: Convert, merge, split, compress, and protect PDF documents.

auth.description:
To get your PDF4me API key:
1. Go to your [API Keys dashboard](https://dev.pdf4me.com/dashboard/#/api-keys/)
2. Sign in or create a free account if you don't have one
3. Copy your API key and paste it here

convert_to_pdf.name: convert_to_pdf
convert_to_pdf.description: Converts a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or image file to PDF format.

file.description: The file to convert. Supported formats: DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF.

filename.description: Name for the resulting PDF file (without the .pdf extension). Defaults to the original filename.

aiMetadata.description: Converts a single office or image file (DOCX/DOC, XLSX/XLS, PPTX/PPT, PNG/JPG/GIF/BMP/TIFF) into a PDF via the PDF4me API. Use when an agent needs a non-PDF document rendered as PDF; the input file is required. A pure conversion that is idempotent — the same input always yields the same PDF with no stored side effect.

merge_pdfs.name: merge_pdfs
merge_pdfs.description: Combines two or more PDF files into a single PDF document.

file1.description: The first PDF file to merge. It will appear first in the merged result.

file2.description: The second PDF file to merge.

filename.description: Name for the merged PDF file (without the .pdf extension).

aiMetadata.description: Merges two PDF files into one combined PDF via the PDF4me API, with the first file placed before the second. Use when an agent needs to concatenate two PDFs into a single document; both PDF files are required. A pure transformation that is idempotent — the same inputs always produce the same merged PDF with no stored side effect.

split_pdf.name: split_pdf
split_pdf.description: Splits a PDF file into multiple documents using one of four split strategies.

splitAction.description: How the PDF should be split.

options.label: Split After Page — split into two parts at a given page
Recurring Split — split into equal chunks every N pages
Split Sequence — split by a sequence of page counts
Split Ranges — split using custom page ranges

auth.description:
To get your PDF4me API key:
1. Go to your [API Keys dashboard](https://dev.pdf4me.com/dashboard/#/api-keys/)
2. Sign in or create a free account if you don't have one
3. Copy your API key and paste it here

aiMetadata.description: Splits a PDF into multiple documents via the PDF4me API using one of four strategies selected by the Split Strategy prop: split after a given page, recurring split every N pages, split by a sequence of page counts, or split by custom ranges; the numeric prop controls the chosen strategy. Use when an agent needs to break one PDF into parts. The PDF file is required. A pure transformation that is idempotent — the same input and settings always produce the same parts with no stored side effect.

compress_pdf.name: compress_pdf
compress_pdf.description: Reduces the file size of a PDF document while maintaining readability.

optimizeProfile.description: Controls the trade-off between file size and output quality.

aiMetadata.description: Reduces the size of a PDF via the PDF4me Optimize API, with an optional compression profile that trades size against quality (web, print, grayscale, or aggressive-maximum modes). Use when an agent needs to shrink a PDF for storage or delivery; the PDF file is required. A pure transformation that is idempotent — the same input and profile always yield the same optimized PDF with no stored side effect.

protect_pdf.name: protect_pdf
protect_pdf.description: Adds password protection to a PDF file so only authorised users can open it.

file.description: The PDF file to protect with a password.

password.description: The password users will need to open the protected PDF.

pdfPermission.description: Permissions granted to users who open the protected PDF.

aiMetadata.description: Encrypts a PDF with an open password via the PDF4me Protect API, optionally restricting permissions (copy, annotate, fill forms, print, etc.). Use when an agent needs to password-protect a PDF before sharing; the PDF file and password are required. A pure transformation that is idempotent — the same input, password, and permission setting always produce an equivalently protected PDF with no stored side effect.

pdf_to_word.name: pdf_to_word
pdf_to_word.description: Converts a PDF file to an editable Microsoft Word (DOCX) document.

file.description: The PDF file to convert to Word format.

qualityType.description: Draft processes the entire file in one API call. High uses per-page processing — best for scanned or image-heavy PDFs.

language.description: Language of the text in the PDF. Used to improve OCR accuracy.

mergeAllSheets.description: Merge all pages into a single Word document sheet.

ocrWhenNeeded.description: Automatically apply OCR when the PDF contains scanned images instead of selectable text.

aiMetadata.description: Converts a PDF into an editable Word (DOCX) document via the PDF4me API, with a quality mode (Draft for one-call processing vs. High per-page processing) and optional OCR for scanned/image-based PDFs. Use when an agent needs the text of a PDF as an editable Word file; the PDF file is required, and setting the correct document language improves OCR accuracy. A pure conversion that is idempotent — the same input and settings always yield the same DOCX with no stored side effect.

pdf_to_image.name: pdf_to_image
pdf_to_image.description: Converts one or more pages of a PDF file to an image.

file.description: The PDF file to convert to an image.

pageNrs.description: Pages to convert. Examples: "1" (first page only), "1,3,5" (specific pages), "2-5" (range), "all" (every page). Defaults to the first page.

widthPixel.description: Output image width in pixels. Height is calculated automatically to maintain the page aspect ratio.

aiMetadata.description: Renders selected pages of a PDF as images via the PDF4me API; the page selection accepts a single page, a comma list, a range, or "all", and the output format (PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP) and width in pixels are configurable. Use when an agent needs a rasterized image of PDF pages rather than the PDF itself; the PDF file is required. A pure transformation that is idempotent — the same input and settings always produce the same image(s) with no stored side effect.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

zh.Convert, merge, split, compress, and pro: Convert, merge, split, compress, and protect PDF documents.
zh.To get your PDF4me API key:\n1. Go to yo:
To get your PDF4me API key:
1. Go to your [API Keys dashboard](https://dev.pdf4me.com/dashboard/#/api-keys/)
2. Sign in or create a free account if you don't have one
3. Copy your API key and paste it here
zh.Converts a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or i: Converts a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or image file to PDF format.
zh.Combines two or more PDF files into a si: Combines two or more PDF files into a single PDF document.
zh.Splits a PDF file into multiple document: Splits a PDF file into multiple documents using one of four split strategies.
zh.Reduces the file size of a PDF document: Reduces the file size of a PDF document while maintaining readability.
zh.Adds password protection to a PDF file s: Adds password protection to a PDF file so only authorised users can open it.
zh.Converts a PDF file to an editable Micro: Converts a PDF file to an editable Microsoft Word (DOCX) document.
zh.Converts one or more pages of a PDF file: Converts one or more pages of a PDF file to an image.
zh.Make a custom API call to a specific end: 将一个自定义 API 调用到一个特定的终点
zh.The file to convert. Supported formats:: The file to convert. Supported formats: DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF.
zh.Name for the resulting PDF file (without: Name for the resulting PDF file (without the .pdf extension). Defaults to the original filename.
zh.The first PDF file to merge. It will app: The first PDF file to merge. It will appear first in the merged result.
The second PDF file to merge.
zh.Name for the merged PDF file (without th: Name for the merged PDF file (without the .pdf extension).
How the PDF should be split.
zh.Controls the trade-off between file size: Controls the trade-off between file size and output quality.
The PDF file to protect with a password.
zh.The password users will need to open the: The password users will need to open the protected PDF.
zh.Permissions granted to users who open th: Permissions granted to users who open the protected PDF.
The PDF file to convert to Word format.
zh.Draft processes the entire file in one A: Draft processes the entire file in one API call. High uses per-page processing — best for scanned or image-heavy PDFs.
zh.Language of the text in the PDF. Used to: Language of the text in the PDF. Used to improve OCR accuracy.
zh.Merge all pages into a single Word docum: Merge all pages into a single Word document sheet.
zh.Automatically apply OCR when the PDF con: Automatically apply OCR when the PDF contains scanned images instead of selectable text.
The PDF file to convert to an image.
zh.Pages to convert. Examples: \"1\" (first: Pages to convert. Examples: "1" (first page only), "1,3,5" (specific pages), "2-5" (range), "all" (every page). Defaults to the first page.
zh.Output image width in pixels. Height is: Output image width in pixels. Height is calculated automatically to maintain the page aspect ratio.
zh.Authorization headers are injected autom: 授权头自动从您的连接中注入。
Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
zh.Split After Page — split into two parts: Split After Page — split into two parts at a given page
zh.Recurring Split — split into equal chunk: Recurring Split — split into equal chunks every N pages

zh.Split Ranges — split using custom page r: Split Ranges — split using custom page ranges

pt.Convert, merge, split, compress, and pro: Converter, mesclar, dividir, comprimir e proteger documentos PDF.
pt.To get your PDF4me API key:\n1. Go to yo:
Para obter sua chave de API PDF4me:
1. Vá para o seu [Painel de Chaves API](https://dev.pdf4me.com/dashboard/#/api-keys/)
2. Entre ou crie uma conta gratuita se você não tiver um
3. Copie sua chave da API e cole-a aqui
pt.Converts a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or i: Converte um arquivo de Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ou imagem de formato PDF.
pt.Combines two or more PDF files into a si: Combina dois ou mais arquivos PDF em um único documento PDF.
pt.Splits a PDF file into multiple document: Divide um arquivo PDF em vários documentos usando uma das quatro estratégias divididas.
pt.Reduces the file size of a PDF document: Reduz o tamanho do arquivo de um documento PDF mantendo a legibilidade.
pt.Adds password protection to a PDF file s: Adiciona proteção de senha a um arquivo PDF para que apenas usuários autorizados possam abri-lo.
pt.Converts a PDF file to an editable Micro: Converte um arquivo PDF para um documento editável do Microsoft Word (DOCX).
pt.Converts one or more pages of a PDF file: Converte uma ou mais páginas de um arquivo PDF para uma imagem.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
pt.The file to convert. Supported formats:: O arquivo para converter. Formatos suportados: DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF.
pt.Name for the resulting PDF file (without: Nome para o arquivo PDF resultante (sem a extensão .pdf). O padrão é o nome original do arquivo.
pt.The first PDF file to merge. It will app: O primeiro arquivo PDF a fazer merge. Ele aparecerá primeiro no resultado da mesclagem.
O segundo arquivo PDF a ser mesclado.
pt.Name for the merged PDF file (without th: Nome para o arquivo PDF mesclado (sem a extensão .pdf).
O arquivo PDF a ser dividido.
Como o PDF deve ser dividido.
pt.Controls the trade-off between file size: Controla a troca entre o tamanho do arquivo e a qualidade de saída.
O arquivo PDF para proteger com uma senha.
pt.The password users will need to open the: Os usuários de senha precisarão abrir o PDF protegido.
pt.Permissions granted to users who open th: Permissões concedidas a usuários que abrem o PDF protegido.
Arquivo PDF para converter para o formato Word
pt.Draft processes the entire file in one A: O rascunho processa todo o arquivo em uma chamada de API. Usa por processamento de página — melhor para PDFs digitalizados ou image-heavy heavy .
pt.Language of the text in the PDF. Used to: Idioma do texto no PDF. Usado para melhorar a precisão dos OCR.
pt.Merge all pages into a single Word docum: Mesclar todas as páginas em uma única folha de documentos de Word.
pt.Automatically apply OCR when the PDF con: Aplicar automaticamente OCR quando o PDF contém imagens escaneadas em vez de texto selecionável.
O arquivo PDF a ser convertido para uma imagem.
pt.Pages to convert. Examples: \"1\" (first: Páginas a converter. Exemplos: "1" (apenas primeira página), "1,3,5" (páginas específicas), "2-5" (intervalo), "todos" (todas as páginas). O padrão é a primeira página.
O formato da imagem de saída.
pt.Output image width in pixels. Height is: Largura da imagem de saída em pixels. Altura é calculada automaticamente para manter a proporção de aspecto da página.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
pt.Split After Page — split into two parts: Dividir Após a Página - dividido em duas partes em uma determinada página
pt.Recurring Split — split into equal chunk: Dividir recorrentemente — dividir em partes iguais a cada N páginas
pt.Split Sequence — split by a sequence of: Separar a Sequência - dividir por uma sequência de páginas contará
pt.Split Ranges — split using custom page r: Dividir Intervalos - Dividir usando intervalos de páginas personalizados
pt.Draft (faster, one call per file): Rascunho (mais rápido, uma chamada por arquivo)
pt.High (slower, better for scanned PDFs): Alto (mais lento, melhor para PDFs escaneados)
